reuse.why: Adds the closed-account check to the existing refuseIfAlreadyLinked guard that every link request already goes through, and moves SimpleFin onto the existing linkProviderAccount.

duplication.why: The check is written once, and folding linkSimpleFinAccount into linkProviderAccount removes a duplicated link body.

placement.why: The pre-link guard is the right layer, though a wrapper named refuseIfAlreadyLinked now also enforces an unrelated closed-account rule without being renamed.

scope.why: Beyond the rule, the diff refactors linkSimpleFinAccount onto linkProviderAccount and reorders an import, which the request does not ask for.

maintainability.why: One guard holds all pre-link refusals; the misleading wrapper name is the main wart.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six *-accounts-link registrations pass through refuseIfAlreadyLinked.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts refuseIfAlreadyLinked, the wrapper applied to the gocardless, simplefin, pluggyai, fintegra, akahu and enablebanking link handlers.
